series.name: Lucky Hai Kya?
series.tagline: Luck nahi, odds stack kiye hain inhone.
series.concept: Everyone sees the moment someone 'makes it.' Nobody sees the 10 years before. This series flips the script — showing what it actually takes to maximize your odds of success. Three types of stories: real people whose single breakthrough changed everything after years of invisible grind. Kids and young adults grinding right now with no guarantee. Parents who rearranged their entire lives for their child's dream. Not motivational. Not pity. Just honest. The unwritten rule: luck is odds, and odds can be stacked.

episodes.caption: Ek family. Do shahar. Papa Lucknow mein. Maa gaon mein. 7 saal ka bachcha har din poochhta hai — Papa kab aayenge? Lucky hogi kya beti? Ya family ne apna ghar todha odds banane ke liye?

episodes.caption: Engineering mein path clear hai. Cooking mein koi guarantee nahi. Phir bhi woh har din kitchen mein hai. Burns le raha hai. Recipes likh raha hai. Lucky hoga kya? Ya odds apne haathon se bana raha hai?

episodes.synopsis: From Patna, Bihar. Anand Kumar — math prodigy. Got admitted to Cambridge but couldn't afford to go. Father was a postal clerk. Started selling papads with his mother to survive. Then started Super 30 in 2002 — coaching 30 underprivileged students for IIT-JEE for free. For 6-7 years nobody outside Patna knew. Then nearly all 30 started cracking IIT-JEE every year. National news. Apne odds stack nahi kar paya. Toh doosron ke liye kiya. 30 bacche. Har saal. That's how odds compound.
episodes.caption: Cambridge nahi ja paaya. Papad becha. Phir 30 bacchon ko IIT bheja. Har saal. Free. Lucky the kya woh bacche? Nahi. Ek aadmi ne apne toote sapne se 30 naye odds banaye. Yeh finale hai. Episode 1 share karo.
